messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: service=inference-gateway, metric=5xx_rate, threshold=6.5%, window=1m. Thread: 1757770000
pagerduty-bot: PD | Alert: inference-gateway | 5xx error-rate spike — paging rotation started.
Sam Liang: Oncall here — acked and taking lead. link: https://pagerduty.com/incident/INC12345
Maya Chen: copying. what's the customer impact? any obvious region? :eyes:
Sam Liang: us-west1 is the hotspot, 5xx ~9% over baseline, spike started ~00:01 UTC. errors concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat/completions
Erin O'Neal: can we flip traffic to stable model-1 (lower mem) or route to dedicated pool? runbook suggests fallback to model-stable-2026
Sam Liang: starting fallback: routing /v1/generate -> model-stable-2026 (canary off). running command:
```
redwood route set --service inference-gateway --path /v1/generate --destination model-stable-2026 --immediate
```
Sam Liang: also increasing pool size for dedicated-east-1 by +3 nodes
Leo Park: I'm warming a hot-pool. will monitor KV cache evictions — last spike shows `kvcache.evictions` up 4x
Maya Chen: customer impact — noticed 4 support tickets with 503s, all non-enterprise. ETA for fallback? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam Liang: fallback applied, traffic flip at 00:04 UTC. initial 1m window shows 5xx down to 3.2% in us-west1
incident-bot: Auto-check: 5xx_rate now 3.2% (was 9.1%). severity downgraded to S3. Recording actions.
Erin O'Neal: great — still keep an eye on tail latency. suggest leaving fallback for 15m and then gradual rollback if stable
Leo Park: adding temporary rate-limit rule for long-running requests (>30s) to prevent token storms:
```
# pseudo-rule
route /v1/generate { rate_limit: 20r/s per ip; max_duration: 30s }
```
Sam Liang: added rule, will watch error budget. paging will stay on until handoff.
Maya Chen: I'll do a quick customer outreach for the 4 impacted tickets — set expectancy
ops-night-oncall: taking over at 00:30 UTC for night shift handoff. Sam — can you post summary and handoff ETA?
Sam Liang: TL;DR: 5xx spike us-west1 -> routed /v1/generate to model-stable-2026, scaled dedicated pool +3, temp rate-limits added. Current 5xx 2.9%. Handoff in 25m. CC @ops-night-oncall
ops-night-oncall: acked — will monitor and escalate if >5% resurge. Thanks team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Closing alert thread for active mitigation — monitoring for 15m cooldown. tags: fallback-applied, temp-rate-limit, pool-scale
